The '''Iotran Guard''' was a military division made up of [[Iotran/Legends|Iotrans]] that served the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] [[Collections and Security Division/Legends|Collections and Security Division]]. One duty of the guard was to maintain order on [[High Port Space Center|High Port]], a city orbiting [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], which they had done for most of the planet's history.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Riklon Tost]] served as captain of the guard. Tost helped [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] escape from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], later commanding [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]] in many battles. He was allowed in the Banking Clan's inner ranks despite not being a Muun.

After the fall of the Republic, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] disbanded the Iotran Guard and took over most of the High Port's operations, including its security.
